LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_MasterProgression.label: Symbiosis of Desire
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_MasterProgression.description: The whispers of a distant will gradually become intuition, and the hidden micromachines respond.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_MasterProgression.extraToolti: Growth stays with the personality. Bonuses apply only in the Master role.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_MasterProgression.stages.0.ex: An unfamiliar intuition quietly takes root.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_MasterProgression.stages.1.ex: Once-indistinct whispers begin to make sense.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_MasterProgression.stages.2.ex: The micromachines grow familiar with their host’s will.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_MasterProgression.stages.3.ex: The once-unfamiliar gift has become almost instinctive.
